correctness.rationale: The ordinary cut complex uses complement of disconnected induced 5-subsets, not total cut. My independent full 2^18 mask enumeration confirmed 324 connected and 8244 disconnected five-sets, exactly 18 induced hexagons and exactly eighteen missing twelve-element faces. The augmented toggle matching has 127840 pairs, leaving an ordinary matching with a single vertex and 2074 critical 12-simplices. The complete 2296998-incidence ordinary Hasse graph topologically sorted to completion. Forman then gives integral 2074 S12 with no attaching maps; Euler identity binom(17,4)-324+18=2074 corroborates but alone would not prove wedge.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a natural canonical girth-six boundary example for k=5 ordinary cut complexes: eighteen induced hexagons specifically defeat the full skeleton premise of general high-girth theorems. The exact 2074 S12 homotopy type and +18 correction supply a motivated finite boundary fact rather than an arbitrary slice or re-evaluation of a known table.

limitations: Ordinary versus total 5-cut distinction essential; only Pappus girth-six fixed graph, not a general girth-six theorem. Private finite computation independently reproduced complete Hasse matching; publication priority not globally guaranteed.
